en: Well, look at you, through all my Wooloo! I'm Milo, Turffield's gym Leader.
My Grass types grow strong and steady, like a good crop. Let's see if your team can weather the harvest!
Oh my! Your team's grown up strong, hasn't it? That was a smashing battle.
Here you are: the Grass Badge, the first of the challenge.
{player} received the Grass Badge from Milo!
Hulbury's gym is next, down Route 5 by the sea. Nessa's Water types will put your team to the test!
Come back any time! The Wooloo have taken quite a liking to you.
